prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one shared panoramic photo for the approved vision-and-mission section of Integrated Solutions Technology, a Nigerian solar energy and IT infrastructure company. Generate a realistic editorial architectural photograph of a contemporary Nigerian commercial campus: tasteful low-rise cream buildings, a glass office facade on the left, secure professionally installed rooftop solar panels on a low-rise building on the right, green landscaped walkways, palm trees and maintained tropical planting. Warm natural morning daylight, credible Nigerian architecture, calm professional atmosphere, real textures and believable scale. A Black Nigerian woman with neat braided hair and a Black Nigerian man with short hair and subtle prescription glasses, both adults in modest clean navy engineering workwear with restrained grey reflective trim and NO LOGOS, stand or walk together reviewing a large paper technical plan in the central walkway. Natural focused expressions, anatomically correct faces and hands. They are a modest part of the scene, not a close-up: show their upper bodies and some walking space, with their faces positioned around the middle height of the frame. Both people must stay near the centre, close together, so a central mobile crop keeps both visible.
Composition: wide landscape about2:1, enough architectural space and sky above and greenery below to safely crop into a3:1 desktop panorama or a4:3 central mobile image. Keep rooftop solar, glass facade, both faces and the plan inside the central safe band. Do not cut heads or hands. This is conceptual company vision imagery, not a verified client project. No readable signs, text, logos, watermarks, client identifiers, outdoor batteries or inverters, sci-fi infrastructure, exaggerated skyscrapers, cranes, hard hats, handshakes, circuit overlays, UI or graphic elements. Premium natural commercial photography with sharp clean detail and true-to-life Nigerian skin tones.
